args.title: Fix issue 4406 in src/ingest/parser.ts
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

The parseStatement function in src/ingest/parser.ts removes the trailing empty line with lines.pop() but still checks for row shape against the header for each line, including potentially an empty line after the last transaction. This causes the 'Malformed row' error when the file ends with a blank line. The fix is to handle or skip blank lines fully and not try to assert their shape.
